title: EvalOtter Intelligence Profile
shortDescription: The flagship assessment. Combines logical reasoning, numerical intelligence, memory, verbal reasoning, spatial intelligence, and pattern recognition into one EvalOtter Score.
longDescription: The EvalOtter Intelligence Profile is the flagship assessment — a broad first read across six cognitive domains: logical reasoning, numerical intelligence, memory, verbal reasoning, spatial intelligence, and pattern recognition. It draws a curated subset of questions from the platform's shared question library (the same items used in the dedicated single-domain assessments), so results are directly comparable to your scores on those assessments. EvalOtter assessments are designed for education, entertainment and self-discovery and are not a substitute for professional psychological, medical or clinical assessment.
sourceNote: Deliberately does NOT port the old airostudio/brainyak repo's 15 'pattern recognition' questions: that repo's data/questions.ts hardcodes correctAnswer:0 for every single question regardless of the actual image content (see src/store/testStore.ts's isCorrect check against that fixed value) — the app's IQ score was cosmetic, not a real assessment. Shipping that would mean the platform's own flagship silently scored on fabricated correctness. Instead, this assessment reuses real, legitimately-scored questions from the sibling single-domain assessments via the shared question library (see reuseQuestionKeys) — the architecture's intended way to compose a multi-domain assessment, per the Question Library principle in the platform spec.

resultRanges.title: Developing
resultRanges.description: Your broad cognitive profile is still forming across the domains tested. This first read is a starting point, not a verdict — the dedicated single-domain assessments will show you exactly where to focus.
recommendations: Take the dedicated assessment for your lowest-scoring domain to get a fuller picture.
Revisit this profile after practicing in your weaker areas.
Use the Brain Profile radar to see your shape at a glance, not just one number.

recommendations: Check your Brain Profile to see which domain is pulling the average down.
Take the single-domain assessments for a more precise read on each area.

resultRanges.title: Strong
resultRanges.description: You perform solidly across logical, numerical, memory, verbal, and spatial reasoning, with a reasonably balanced profile.
recommendations: Take the dedicated assessments to sharpen your understanding of each individual domain.

Retake periodically — this composite is a good way to track overall change over time.

resultRanges.title: Very Strong

recommendations: Take the single-domain assessments to find your single sharpest edge.

recommendations: Explore the full catalogue — Emotional Intelligence and Creative Assessment measure dimensions this profile doesn't touch.
